provenance: Host-authored direct program with constructor/source review, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.author: host
draft_notes.mechanism: Match framed holes to gallery colour shapes preserving the transverse within-slot offset, translating only along the gallery stacking axis. All candidate frames, sides and colour matches must give a unique answer. Each demonstration must fit the same mechanism.
draft_notes.review: Original fixtures all match aligned-slot rule; normalized silhouette-only archive fallback is insufficient for reachable translated twins. Explicit twin counterexample retained and tested under all D4.
draft_notes.constructor_change: Skip empty random shape before common.connected(shape), which otherwise indexes an empty list. No valid draw removed; dimensions, connectivity, full-height condition and shape uniqueness unchanged.
draft_notes.limitations: Finite random audit not a general proof. Ambiguous or malformed visible galleries reject; independent gate consumes no query answers.
draft_notes.tests: 6 tests including native translated twins, duplicate aligned shapes, canonical fixtures, background palette changes, query-label poisoning, absent gallery and empty-draw safety.
